examples.observation: PDP free shipping on orders over $150 vs homepage banners over $250; market/product/rule conditions not confirmed
examples.vsn_rule: One merchant-defined rule per qualified market/product or explicitly labeled exceptions; do not mix promises.

examples.observation: PDP describes two-year repair warranty, earrings collection includes three-year warranty tile; applicability may differ
examples.vsn_rule: Warranty on a PDP must be tied to merchant-defined product or collection policy and auditable provenance.

examples.observation: Crossed-out $0.00 printed on some product cards; static HTML only, not verified visual display state
examples.vsn_rule: Hide compare-at markup unless compare_at > price and compare_at > 0.

examples.observation: A timed flash sale displays units and offer terms but true expiry and stock claims were not confirmed
examples.vsn_rule: Merchant-provided timestamp, timezone and expiry; no fake urgency or selling-fast labels.

examples.observation: Mini-kit and Pink Coconut bundle pricing advertises savings, but multi-SKU Add-to-cart interactions were not tested
examples.vsn_rule: Do not mark multi-line transactional bundle verified from merchandising copy alone.

examples.observation: Page HTML includes Item added to your cart notification markup despite no action being executed
examples.vsn_rule: Static hidden UI markup is not evidence that a successful cart mutation occurred.
